risk_summary: The disclosure is highly quantified and provides useful year-over-year drivers, but it reflects meaningful operating pressure, including declining revenue, advertising weakness, reduced operating cash flow, and substantial impairment charges. The outlook relies on economic recovery and expected event-driven advertising, while extensive non-GAAP and forward-looking caveats temper confidence in underlying liquidity and performance.
